description: Antifraud p.1 (olife_antifraud, 16.10): IP bans everywhere. One source — the supervisor table bans (kind ip, address or CIDR, until, reason). Admin chat `/ban ip`, CLI `lab olife ban --ip` (= olife.ban), panel (POST olife.fraud via=panel); the session from the address is kicked at once (Disconnect 5 with the reason); the auth service answers ip_banned «бан по IP … до …» (nick and token logins); the gateway refuses the address before Hello; CIDR; a ban covering 127.0.0.1 is refused; /bans, /unban ip, /players (admin: IP, player: masked); audit chat/cli/panel. Then the engine menu client (F2F 0.32) through a TCP relay with source 127.0.0.77: status screen [banned ip_banned] -> unban -> Повторить -> play -> IP ban in game -> Disconnect 5 on the screen. Test addresses 127.0.0.2..254 only; everything is lifted by olife_fraud_cleanup.
